{{Top|leg}}
'''Encryption code T33-A''' was utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The code was used by Alliance [[operative]]s to access [[comm channel 2588.3]], which was monitored as part of [[Drop Point: Condor]] in [[System M132L4]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
